context:
Goal: CI changes pay for themselves.
Problem (cost): the review of mailaudit #322 failed it on your ruling 176 b (keep non-macOS push suites until claude-settings changes the red-main check). The change would save about 15 to 20 s of a 236 s run on 3 runners.
Based on (ruling): 176 b (21:45 CST Nov 12).
Based on (measured): the reviewer's numbers, 15 to 20 s of 236 s, 3 runners.
Departs from: mailaudit main, which runs all push suites — a leaves it that way and drops #322; the push trim waits on item 729.

options.gain: No review-failed change on your ruling 176 b; no code to keep.
options.how: The PR (test shards and a doc-path trim on push) closes. The push trim waits on your answer to item 729.
options.label: Close mailaudit #322 as not worth it (coordinator's pick)
options.lose: About 15 to 20 s of a 236 s run (3 runners) is not saved.

options.how: A lane reworks the shards and the trim so the review passes.
options.label: Keep #322 open and rework it
options.lose: More work on a change its reviewer failed against 176 b.

reply: Filed 13:21 CST: your 732 b is ruling own-732-b-keep-322. Mailaudit #322 stays open and a lane reworks it. The push trim still waits on your item 729 answer (push-skip-proven-tree). The coordinator starts the lane.

shown.label: Close mailaudit #322 as not worth it (coordinator's pick)

title: Close mailaudit PR #322 (test shards and a doc-path push trim) as not worth it?
why: The coordinator took this pick; it stands unless you choose b.
